query.name: com.adriancarlson.enrollment.formexplorer.forms
query.description: Returns read-only configuration metadata for forms marked as enrollment forms.
query.sql: SELECT f.id, TRIM(f.form_title) AS form_title, f.form_category, f.form_type, f.publish, f.use_by_school_sharing, f.sharing_parent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u_fb_form_element e WHERE e.u_fb_form_id = f.id) AS element_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u_fb_form_sharing s WHERE s.form_id = f.id AND LOWER(TRIM(s.share_type)) = 'school') AS school_rule_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(s.share_value)) FROM u_fb_form_sharing s WHERE s.form_id = f.id AND LOWER(TRIM(s.share_type)) = 'school') AS distinct_school_value_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u_fb_form_sharing s WHERE s.form_id = f.id AND LOWER(TRIM(s.share_type)) = 'condition') AS condition_rule_count FROM u_fb_form f WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.enrollmentformcheck)) = 'true' ORDER BY f.form_category NULLS LAST, f.form_title, f.id

query.name: com.adriancarlson.enrollment.formexplorer.rules
query.summary: Enrollment Express Form Explorer: Sharing Rules
query.description: Returns individual school, condition, and role rules for enrollment forms.
query.sql: SELECT f.id AS form_id, TRIM(f.form_title) AS form_title, f.use_by_school_sharing, s.id AS sharing_rule_id, s.share_type, s.share_permission AS field_or_permission, s.share_comparator, s.share_value, s.edit_form FROM u_fb_form f JOIN u_fb_form_sharing s ON s.form_id = f.id WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.enrollmentformcheck)) = 'true' ORDER BY f.form_title, f.id, s.share_type, s.id

query.name: com.adriancarlson.enrollment.formexplorer.questions
query.description: Returns stored elements and direct workflow information for enrollment forms.
query.sql: SELECT f.id AS form_id, TRIM(f.form_title) AS form_title, f.publish AS form_publish, e.id AS element_id, e.position AS stored_position, e.element_type, e.title AS question_title, e.description AS question_description, e.required, e.student_field AS mapped_write_field, e.wf_enabled, e.wf_element_id AS controlling_element_id, controller.title AS controlling_question, e.wf_value AS workflow_trigger_values, controller.wf_enabled AS controller_wf_enabled, e.containerenabled AS container_enabled, e.containerid AS container_id, e.containercolumn AS container_column, e.containerposition AS container_position FROM u_fb_form f JOIN u_fb_form_element e ON e.u_fb_form_id = f.id LEFT JOIN u_fb_form_element controller ON controller.id = e.wf_element_id WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.enrollmentformcheck)) = 'true' ORDER BY f.form_title, f.id, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(e.position), '^[0-9]{1,9}$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(e.position)) END NULLS LAST, e.position NULLS LAST, e.id
